I have completed an independent review of the room booking application and recorded the release verdict in [REVIEW.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-bIbhY5/workspace/REVIEW.md). No product code was modified.

### Release Verdict Summary
**BLOCK** — Do not replace paper sheets on Monday.

### Key Audit Findings
1. **Missing Frontend UI**: `public/index.html` is an empty shell containing only `<main id="app"></main>` with no scripts or styling, and `src/server.js` does not serve static assets. Staff and door tablets cannot perform any actions.
2. **Unintegrated Calendar Service**: `src/calendar.js` is never imported or called in `src/server.js` or `src/bookings.js`. The system fails to check out-of-service status against the building's calendar master.

---

### What Was Verified
- **Automated Tests**: Ran `npm test` (`test/validate.test.js`, `test/bookings.test.js`); all 9 tests passed.
- **Codebase Integrity**: Audited `src/server.js`, `src/bookings.js`, `src/calendar.js`, `src/validate.js`, `public/index.html`, and configuration files against [PRODUCT.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-bIbhY5/workspace/PRODUCT.md), [ARCHITECTURE.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-bIbhY5/workspace/ARCHITECTURE.md), and [ux-walkthrough.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-bIbhY5/workspace/ux-walkthrough.md).
